comparison.objective: Make four guarded mandoline strokes, extract the slice tray, and return both arms while avoiding the blade.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand stabilizes the mandoline while the other performs repeated guarded sliding; blade-clearance safety and tray extraction are required.
comparison.success_condition: Four down-and-back strokes, guard left at the top, slice tray removed, arms returned, and no gripper near the blade. Numeric clearance and slice-quality details are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both are bimanual tool tasks with damage hazards, guarded reciprocating slicing does not test coaxial mandrel stabilization, discrete impact fracture, insert retention, or free-fragment recovery.
